info.description:
## Milestone 4 - Fintrack

This collection covers the core REST API endpoints for a personal finance management application. It provides full **CRUD** (Create, Read, Update, Delete) operations across four primary resources:

- **Users** — Manage user accounts: list all users, retrieve a user by ID, create, update, and delete users.
    
- **Accounts** — Handle financial accounts (e.g. bank accounts): list all accounts, retrieve by ID, create, update, and delete accounts.
    
- **Categories** — Organize transaction categories: list all categories, retrieve by ID, create, update, and delete categories.
    
- **Transactions** — Track financial transactions: list all transactions, retrieve by ID, create, update, and delete transactions.
    

### Base URL

All requests use the `{{deploy-link}}` environment variable as the base URL. Make sure this variable is set to the correct deployment URL in your active environment before sending requests.

### Endpoints Summary

| Resource | GET All | GET by ID | POST | PATCH | DELETE |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Users | `GET /users` | `GET /users/1` | `POST /users` | `PATCH /users/1` | `DELETE /users/2` |
| Accounts | `GET /accounts` | `GET /accounts/1` | `POST /accounts` | `PATCH /accounts/1` | `DELETE /accounts/2` |
| Categories | `GET /categories` | `GET /categories/1` | `POST /categories` | `PATCH /categories/1` | `DELETE /categories/2` |
| Transactions | `GET /transactions` | `GET /transactions/1` | `POST /transactions` | `PATCH /transactions/1` | `DELETE /transactions/2` |

## AllAccounts

Retrieves a list of all accounts associated with the authenticated user.

### Request Details

- **Method:** `GET`
    
- **Endpoint:** `{{deploy-link}}/accounts`
    

The base URL is dynamically resolved using the `{{deploy-link}}` environment variable, which should be set to the appropriate deployment URL in the active environment.

### Response

Returns a JSON array of account objects. Each object includes the following fields:

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | number | Unique account identifier |
| `userId` | number | ID of the owning user |
| `name` | string | Display name of the account (e.g. `"BCA Personal"`) |
| `type` | string | Account type (e.g. `"BANK"`) |
| `balance` | string | Current account balance |
| `createdAt` | string | ISO 8601 timestamp of account creation |
| `updatedAt` | string | ISO 8601 timestamp of last update |

### Test Scripts

The following automated tests are included and run after each response:

- ✅ **Status code is 200** — Asserts the response returns an HTTP `200 OK` status.
    
- ⚡ **Response time is less than 3000ms** — Ensures the API responds within 3 seconds.
    
- 📦 **Response body is not empty** — Verifies the response body contains data.
    
- 🗂️ **Content-Type is JSON** — Confirms the response header includes `application/json`.
